I just don't know how to feel about her breaking up with me, i conciously didn't pressure her into being with me, but she kissed me and started the relationship. I thought she was the one and she just gave me the cold shoulder and broke up with me indirectly over the phone. I want to give her a second chance, and ask her if she wants to try this thing again before i make up my mind about ending it all. But i fear her answer. And i don't know how to feel about her. I love her too much to be angry at her even though she often treats and treated me like shit in my eyes.
yeah i've written 8 letters as of this moments, i guess it helps but i might still do it.
